summary: The change also edits .aidd/config.yaml, and the edit changes profile, a control key: the config file stays protected, so the change needs major.

ops.value:
aidd_version: "1.0.0"
profile: solo
changed_lines_exclude_paths: ["**/package-lock.json"]
owners:
  default_owner_team: checkout
  approvers: ["@checkout-lead", "@platform-lead", "@oncall-lead"]
  specialists:
    security: ["@sec-alice"]
tests:
  - name: unit
    command: [make, test]
standard_changes:
  - name: dependency-patch
    paths: [package.json, package-lock.json]
    authors: ["dependabot[bot]"]
    max_changed_lines: 300
identities:
  system_accounts: [web-flow]
  bots: ["claude[bot]"]
